name: Gakkou Nanafushigi 2
source:
Spring. Main character returns to the alma mater as an apprentice. High school was a memorable time, and the incident about two girls disappearance never got solved. Protagonist goes to explore night school...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
春天，主人公以实习生的身份回到母校。高中时光令人难忘，而当年两名少女失踪的事件至今仍未解决。主人公决定在夜里探索学校……
